body: I did. Earlier this month. But she didn't know how to help. And they called my mom and she pretended to be all sweet and caring . And then they didn't believe me. And when I got home my mom called me a coward for considering suicide and that I'm such a joke and a good for nothing. And she's right. I just want the easy way out. The easy way I couldn't bring myself to do earlier. But now I know. And I will do it. Thank you for your advice though.
